risk_summary: The disclosure is generally informative and includes meaningful quantitative details on acreage, occupancy, revenue, project funding, and liquidity. However, it relies heavily on optimistic strategic language and forward-looking assumptions, while key timing, profitability, financing dependence, and project-cost details remain uncertain or incomplete. Liquidity and execution risks are material because debt service and development spending may depend on asset sales, credit availability, presale deposits, and construction financing.
